Added runCommandVersionDiagnostics: a Hint pass (Code 'version-introduced') that flags a command whose clean MinVersion is later than the running version (! version X comment). compareVersions is conservative — only pure-numeric dot-versions compare; non-numeric components (e.g. '3.9S', '15.7(3)M') are treated as incomparable and never flagged. Only the introduced-after signal ships: MaxVersion/deprecated-before is intentionally omitted because the scraper's MaxVersion is too unreliable (thousands of clean-numeric MaxVersion values sit below a modern running version — e.g. hostname=15.0 — and would flood clean configs with false positives, violating the AC). Refactored the running-version extraction into a shared runningVersion() helper used by both version passes. Wired into runDiagnostics after version-mismatch. Table-driven TestCommandVersionDiagnostics (hostname 12.2 under 12.1 fires; under 12.2/15.0/absent-run does not) + TestCompareVersions. make test green; no existing golden fixture changes.

createItems now sets CompletionItem.Detail = 'Enters <EnterMode> mode' for mode-opening commands (interface -> config-if, router bgp -> config-router, archive -> config-archive, class-map -> config-cmap, etc.), gated to skip negated forms ('no interface') which do not enter the mode. Added TestCompletionEnterModeDetail (interface/router bgp/router ospf/archive/class-map carry the right mode substring; 'no interface' and non-mode-opening 'hostname' carry none). Deliverable (a) only: the optional (b) body-validation diagnostic is deferred — it is out of the AC and carries false-positive risk. No conflict with chunter-pwz: this is completion-only (Detail field), touches no diagnostics. make test (CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -race) green; existing goldens unchanged (formatCompletion is label-based).

Added runProtocolMismatchDiagnostics (SeverityError, Code 'protocol-mismatch'): flags a command owned by one routing protocol when used inside another protocol's router/address-family section (e.g. OSPF 'area' under 'router bgp'). Hybrid registry: nodeKindToProtocol for dedicated *_statement kinds (aggregate_address_statement/graceful_restart_statement->bgp, auto_cost_statement->ospf, plus summary_prefix/metric_style listed for completeness/future-proofing) and keywordToProtocol for deferred command_line nodes ('area'->ospf; 'distance ospf' omitted as ambiguous per spec). Own protocol resolved from the map; enclosing protocol from section.EnclosingSection (chunter-mpc), which inherits through address-family and up through negated_statement. Shared commands (network/neighbor/redistribute) are absent from the registry -> never flagged. Message format: <cmd> is a/an <PROTO-UPPER> command, not valid under "router <enclosing>"; bare-keyword cmds quoted, node-kind cmds unquoted; article is a/an by owning-protocol initial. Wired into runDiagnostics after runWrongSectionDiagnostics. Table-driven diagnostics_protocol_test.go covers every AC case (area/aggregate-address/auto-cost/graceful-restart mismatches; same-protocol/shared/top-level negatives; negated descent; address-family inheritance; clean multi-protocol false-positive guard). Verified summary-address has no summary_prefix_statement grammar node today (splits to command_line+text) — out of v1 scope. make test green; clean_all_sections golden unaffected.
